publicNote: Their publicly posted cash board, read from the same feed their own website reads. Cash and basis are their own commercial numbers. The futures quote is carried only so a consumer can re-check cash minus basis; it is not redistributed as a price feed.
note:
READ THROUGH THEIR OWN PAGE, holding no credential: Bushel's board is fetched by the customer's site in the reader's browser, so loading that page is the whole of the authorisation. One call to GetBidsList carries every location this operator quotes, so each of them is a source file and none of them is new code -- the adapter has been reading CHS Farmers Alliance live since 2026-08-25.

MEASURED BY scripts/bushel-probe.mjs ON 2026-08-25, not guessed. 10 rows here, and floor-to-the-cent explained EVERY one of them -- as it did at all 14 locations on this board and at all 85 across the eight boards that answered. Corn trades in quarter cents and this board displays cash to the whole cent, so the residuals come out in quarters; floor makes the cash - basis = futures identity exact again, which is why no tolerance is set here and none is wanted.

THE STATE AND STREET ARE NOT IN THE PAYLOAD. Bushel's location object is {id, name, groups} and nothing else, so both were read off CHS Ag Services's own locations page on 2026-08-25. That is not pedantry: CHS Herman is a Minnesota co-operative and its WILMOT is in SOUTH DAKOTA. Anyone filling these in from the operator's address gets that one wrong and it looks right for ever.

locationId is the UUID because that is the key their payload uses, and a display name is the thing a vendor re-cases. CANOLA IS WITHHELD, MEASURED 2026-08-26. This board posts canola against RSX26 -- ICE Canada canola, quoted in CANADIAN DOLLARS PER TONNE (789.70) -- beside a cash figure in US dollars per hundredweight (23.96). cash - basis = futures has no meaning across a different unit AND a different currency, and the guard was reporting the board out by seventy thousand cents every half hour as a result. foreignQuote names the prefix so those rows are withheld and NAMED rather than published unverified or silently dropped. The cash bids are real; they are simply not numbers this system can prove, and proving them is the whole job. DISABLED 2026-08-26 after the measurement it was waiting for. With foreignQuote declared, the board answered: ALL TEN of its rows are canola, and the feed names the unit itself -- "Canola USD/CWT (cwt)" against RSX26/RSF27/RSH27/RSK27/RSX27/RSF28, ICE Canada, Canadian dollars per tonne. There is nothing on this board whose cash can be checked against its own quote, so there is nothing here this system can prove, and publishing what it cannot prove is the one thing it does not do. Off rather than refusing every half hour: a source that refuses forever is noise in the one place that must stay meaningful. Turn it back on the day they post corn or beans beside the canola.
